屬性以及不將房地產作為短期刺激經濟的手段        become a consensus that housing is primarily used for residence and that real
已成共識；因城、因區、因勢施策加大了市場        estate trading cannot be a short-term economic stimulus. Policies adapting to
在城市、地域維度的冷暖不均，也加速了行業        local realities has led to growing differences between one regional market to
集中度的提升。外部環境的複雜化與不確定性        another, where some are doing well while some are not. Meanwhile, the uneven
成為常態，規模、速度等單一維度不再成為企        development across the sector has also accelerated the industry’s integration. In
業競爭的標尺，產品、服務、運營、資本等綜        this increasingly complicated and uncertain market, the appropriate benchmark

有效的風險管理是本集團達致戰略目標的基本    Effective risk management is the basic and necessary factor for achieving
及必要因素，為此本集團已制定《龍湖集團風    strategic goals of the Group. As such, the Group has established the Risk
險管理制度》。制度中明確了本集團風險管理組   Management System of Longfor Group , which specifies the Group ’s risk
織體系及具體職責、風險管理整體流程、風險    management organizational system, detailed responsibility, overall procedures
評估方法，以及定期的風險報告機制。       of risk management, risk assessment method and regular risk reporting
                        mechanism.

風險管理組織體系：龍湖集團的風險管理組織    Risk management organizational system: The risk management organizational
體系是董事會領導下的三道基本防線，即公司    system of Longfor Group consists of three basic lines of defense under the
業務職能部門的管理層和員工為第一道防線；    leadership of the Board, namely the business departments directly under the
由集團職能部門負責人組成的，CEO為組長、   Company as the first line of defense; the risk management team consisting of
CFO為副組長的風險管理小組為第二道防線；   the general manager of functional departments of the Group with the CEO as
審核委員會和內審中心為第三道防線。董事會    team leader and CFO as deputy team leader as the second line of defense; and
是風險管理的最終責任機構，有權對集團風險    the Audit Committee and internal audit centre as the third line of defense.
管理的政策制度及應對方案進行指引和最終決    The Board shall be the ultimate accountability body of risk management,
策，評估集團風險偏好，把握在戰略目標實現    and shall have the right to provide guidance and make final decisions on the
及風險管理之間的匹配度；審核委員會和內審    policy, system and responding plan of risk management of the Group, conduct
中心由董事會委派，對公司風險管理的實施情    assessment on the risk appetite of the Group and control the balance between
況進行指導監控，並審閱年度風險管理報告；    the realization of strategic goals and risk management. The Audit Committee
風險管理小組負責不斷完善風險管理體系，執    and internal audit centre are authorized by the Board to advise on and monitor
行包括風險識別、評估、應對方案以及風險管    the implementation of risk management of the Group and review the annual
理報告的管理流程，包括年度更新風險庫，對    risk management report. The risk management team is responsible for the
應對方案實施進行跟蹤監控，編製並匯報風險    ongoing improvement of risk management system as well as the implementation
管理報告。業務部門是風險所有者，對各自的    of management procedures including risk identification, assessment, responding

     重大性議題判定                                                    MATERIALITY ANALYSIS
     本集團按照《環境、社會及管治報告指引》的要                                      In accordance with the requirements of the Environmental, Social and
     求，通過與各類利益相關方不同形式的互動與                                       Governance Reporting Guide, the Group conducted benchmarking analysis
     溝通，對同行業企業ESG報告披露的議題進行                                      on issues disclosed in the ESG reports of peer companies in the same industry
     對標分析，識別本集團2019年ESG重大議題，                                    through different forms of interaction and communication with various
     確定報告邊界。                                                    stakeholders to identify the ESG materiality issues of the Group in 2019 and
                                                                determine the scope of reporting.

     2019 年，本集團 E S G 重大性議題判定流程如                                In 2019, the Group’s ESG materiality issues were analyzed as follows:
     下：


     1.    識別相關議題               議題識別由獨立第三方顧問進行，共評估收集了17個涵蓋環境、勞工、營運和社區四個方面的ESG議題。
                                這些議題通過廣泛數據源徵得，其中包括香港聯交所ESG指引、公司政策及管理策略、行業對標、ESG評
                                級體系分析等。
           Identification of    The identification of issues was carried out by an independent third-party consultant. A total of 17 ESG issues covering
           relevant issues      four aspects, namely environmental, labor, operation and community, were identified. Such issues were identified
                                through a wide range of data sources, including the Hong Kong Stock Exchange ESG Reporting Guide , company
                                policies and management strategies, industry benchmarking and ESG rating system analysis.


     2.    調研關注程度               獨立第三方顧問對利益相關方進行問卷調查，邀請包括普通員工、供應商、客戶、投資者、政府機構、監
                                管機構、社區代表、合作夥伴、非政府組織、媒體等利益相關方從自身角度評價各議題的重要性程度，共
                                回收2,136份有效問卷。
           Research and         The independent third-party consultant conducted a questionnaire survey of stakeholders, and invited stakeholders
           analysis on the      including ordinary employees, suppliers, customers, investors, government agencies, regulatory authorities, community
           degree of concern representatives, cooperative partners, non-governmental organizations and media to evaluate the materiality of each issue
                                from their own perspective, and collected 2,136 valid questionnaires in total.


     3.    分析運營影響               獨立第三方顧問通過分析集團年度業務重點，向管理層徵求意見，從集團角度評估議題對集團的重要性，
                                共回收40份有效問卷。
           Analysis of          The independent third-party consultant analyzed the Group’s annual operational focus and collected opinions from the
           operational          management to evaluate the materiality of the issues to the Group from the Group’s perspective, and collected 40 valid
           impact               questionnaires in total.


     4.    確定議題排序               根據議題對各利益相關方的重要性和議題對本集團的重要性兩個參數，對這些議題作出重要性排序，以矩
                                陣形式進行披露。該重大性議題矩陣將作為今後本集團ESG戰略制定、目標設置與持續信息披露的重要參
                                考。
           Determination        According to the materiality of issues to each stakeholder and to the Group, the issues are sorted by materiality and
           of the priority of   disclosed in a matrix. The materiality matrix will serve as an important reference for the formulation, goal setting and
           issues               continuous information disclosure of the Group’s ESG strategy in the future.

     實際利率法為計算金融資產或金融負債            The effective interest method is a method of calculating the amortised
     的攤銷成本及按有關期間攤分利息收入            cost of a financial asset or financial liability and of allocating interest
     利息開支的方法。實際利率是將金融資            income and interest expense over the relevant period. The effective
     產或金融負債於預計年期或（倘適用）較           interest rate is the rate that exactly discounts estimated future cash
     短期間的估計未來現金收入或付款（包括           receipts and payments (including all fees paid or received that form an
     構成實際利率不可分割部分的已支付或            integral part of the effective interest rate, transaction costs and other
     收取的所有費用、交易成本及其他溢價            premiums or discounts) through the expected life of the financial asset
     或折價）準確折現至初步確認的賬面淨值           or financial liability, or, where appropriate, a shorter period to the net
     的利率。                         carrying amount on initial recognition.

  本集團根據經營租賃出租各公寓及零售        The Group leases out various apartments and retail stores under operating
  店舖，須按月支付租金。租賃的初始期        leases with rentals payable monthly. The leases typically run for an initial
  限一般為1個月至20年，僅承租人擁有單      period of 1 month to 20 years, with unilateral rights to extend the lease
  方延長初始期限的權利。零售店舖的租        beyond initial period held by lessees only. The leases of retail stores
  賃包含按1%至28%銷售計算的浮動租賃      contain variable lease payment that are based on 1% to 28% sales and
  付款及根據租賃期限固定的最低年度租        minimum annual lease payment that are fixed over the lease term.
  賃付款。


  本集團因租賃安排未面臨外幣風險，原        The Group is not exposed to foreign currency risk as a result of the lease
  因為所有租賃均以集團實體各自的功能        arrangements, as all leases are denominated in the respective functional
  貨幣計值。租賃合約並無載列剩餘價值        currencies of group entities. The lease contracts do not contain residual
  擔保及 ╱ 或承租人於租期結束時購買物      value guarantee and/or lessee’s option to purchase the property at the end
  業的權利。                    of lease term.

                   整票面利息及投資者可選擇於有權調整票                                 the coupon rate and the investors have the option to sell back the bonds between the

                   間按面值回售債券或持有至到期。                                    the option at par or hold until maturity.


            除二零一五年第一批債券及中期票據                                    Except for the 2015 First Tranche Bonds and the Medium-term Notes, all
            外，所有其他債券包含負債部分及提早                                   other bonds contain a liability component and early redemption options:
            贖回選擇權：


            (i)    負債部分指計及本公司的業務風險                              (i)     Liability component represents the contractually determined
                   及財務風險後按可比較信用狀況的                                      stream of future cash flows discounted at the rate of interest
                   市場工具所釐定的利率折現未來現                                      determined by the market instruments of comparable credit status
